sources.title: H1 · Cross-protocol, game-typed certificate format
sources.subtitle: Novelty hypothesis
sources.summary: A machine-checkable certificate that ties every ε to a named game (W1, W1_CV, S1, S2, D1, …), a theorem ID with a source anchor, assumption flags (e.g. P03 Table 6 A–G), and an evidence kind.

sources.title: H2 · Systematic optimisation over published bounds
sources.subtitle: Novelty hypothesis
sources.summary: Treat P03 Lemmas 2–3 + Thm 1 (and P04 eqs.(19)–(23), P05 Thm 1) as *fixed, cited* constraints and search the free parameters (γ_det, γ_err, ν_cor, ν_unf, N, δ_h, δ_d) to minimise resource cost at fixed ε. Report the gap against each paper's published tuple. *…

sources.title: H3 · Uncertainty-aware calibration from public raw data
sources.subtitle: Novelty hypothesis
sources.summary: Estimate (e, l, p_m) intervals from the Zenodo timetags with time-blocked holdouts and drift stress.

sources.title: H4 · Independent reproduction and consistency audit
sources.subtitle: Novelty hypothesis
sources.summary: Re-derive P04's N=1 SDP and P01's SDP with residual accounting.

sources.title: H5 · Falsification harness
sources.subtitle: Novelty hypothesis
sources.summary: Pair every certified configuration with the best known *attack* (Monte Carlo lower bounds, SDP optima at small n) so certificates can be shown to be non-vacuous and to fail when they should.

sources.title: H6 · Trust-matched quantum vs classical systems benchmark
sources.subtitle: Novelty hypothesis
sources.summary: Compare on matched topology/trust.

glossary.definition: Lane A read the full text of the primary source.
Only the abstract (and possibly skimmed PDF) was read; theorem details are not verified.
Only bibliographic metadata was checked; content is not verified.
Field read in the primary source at the anchor given.
Field not checked against the primary source; see the reason.
Lane A recomputed a published number from the transcribed formula (a consistency check, not a proof).
Lane D reproduced the published bound in code with an independent check.
Numerically reproduced, but a hypothesis is open; never certified.
Numerical value with exactly verified residual accounting.
Stated, not proven.
No theorem or evidence supports this obligation yet.
Correction issued by the authors or publisher.
Dataset/code version differences recorded by lane A.
Inconsistency observed by lane A; not an erratum, to be resolved by the named lanes.
Discrepancy checked and found consistent.
Possible contribution; must survive the listed conflicts and outside review.
Prior art that blocks a novelty claim until resolved.
Statements that must never appear in code, docs, UI or paper.
Record metadata and archive listing checked via the public API.
File downloaded and checksum verified.
Some fields verified; see caveats.
